title: GitLab Runner authentication token: one-property twin (alphabet)
summary: 1 input is identical to a positive input except for one change: a character outside the documented alphabet is present. Legacy mutation notes: alphabet: one base36 letter in the length/checksum tail uppercased; GitLab's generator (Integer#to_s(36)) and its provider-authored rule ([0-9a-z]) emit lowercase only. Twin of "GitLab Runner authentication token: must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.
